title: Root-power generator formula for an ordinary finite Tate transition
statement: For the two finite realized root-tensor sheaves at a<=b, restrict their actions to the completed coefficient ring. FiniteRootTransition(T,ell,d,b,a,hab,r,f) requires that f send every local scalar/root tensor to the lower-level tensor, applying the quotient map to the scalar section and constant coefficient, and r.roots to every root. The condition quantifies over every etale U, pro-etale W over U, coefficient s, quotient scalar section t, and root tuple. It includes d=0 and equal indices.

lean.statement:
def FiniteRootTransition
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (d b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (r : CoefficientLineComparison
      (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
      (ell ^ (b + 1)) (ell ^ (a + 1))
      (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T)
    (f : (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) b)).obj
        ((realization T ell b).obj (finiteSheaf T ell b d)) ⟶
      (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) a)).obj
        ((realization T ell a).obj (finiteSheaf T ell a d))) : Prop
